verifier_note: Every url re-opened. sentinel-echo.com, franklinfavorite.com and richardmoloney.com did not resolve through WebFetch twice and were read with the kit's own fetcher; all three confirmed. Kelly Bush's source line no longer names an author, since the byline could not be confirmed. The Franklin County Democratic Party's page says it endorses the candidates it lists for 2026.
note: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out after three searches for this part, and many county, PVA and school-district sites did not resolve, so most of the 30 candidates (constables, magistrates, jailer, coroner, county clerk, county attorney, PVAs, two school boards) were not found on any page that could be read and are left blank. Party pages that list a candidate without endorsing (Boone County Democrats for Tracey Reid, Madison County Democrats for Leah Van Winkle, Fayette County Democrats for Richard Moloney) are support, already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json, and are not recorded here. Berea's council page and Newport's Board of Commissioners page do not list Leah Van Winkle or Jacob Harrod, so no office is recorded for them. Dwayne Depp's campaign site answered the kit's fetcher 403 and was read through WebFetch; it gives no year for his appointment as sheriff ('earlier this year'), so none is recorded.
